text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just before the Kyoto Daishoten,
a piece of news suddenly came in."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Huh... Suzuka-san won the
Mainichi Okan by running away from the front, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka.
Her overwhelming speed as a front runner has earned her many fans,
and she is a formidable powerhouse known as the "Otherworldly Fugitive."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, a safety lead
against Grass-chan and El?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
As expected of another dimension.
Tokyo must have been quite a spectacle.
choice_data_list: I can't afford to fall behind either!
We can't afford to fall behind either!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You're right.
Let's go all out!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Look who's talking after egging me on.
I mean, come on, it sounded fun, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If Suzuka-san can runaway with pure speed, then I—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Before you know it, Sei-chan magic puts us in 1st place♪
Let's liven up the West just like that!"
